title: Squamish Howe Sound Explorer Private Tour
includes: Private driver guide and premium transportation
Sea to Sky Gondola and Capilano Suspension Bridge Park tickets. Ticket price subject to change (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Children must be accompanied by an adult
A maximum of 11 people per booking
policies: Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy the best of Vancouver and Squamish with a Local Guide. 

You will visit and explore beautiful Howe Sound, Shannon Waterfall, and ride a gondola to 885 meters above sea level to enjoy a magnificent view of Howe Sound and the Pacific Northwest coastline. Spot bald eagles at Brackendale (November- January). At Squamish, you will hunt - for a Broom-riding Witch. Later in the afternoon, you will visit Capilano Suspension Bridge Park and the Salmon Hatchery.

Enjoy skip the line entrance at Capilano Suspension Bridge Park and special group rate tickets.
